# Power BI

Power BI files (`.pbix` / `.pbip`) for the DataCo analysis live here.

**Source:** `data/processed/dataco.parquet`, generated by the ETL:

```bash
cd src && ../.venv/bin/python -m dataco.transform
```

In Power BI: Get Data > Parquet > select the file. To refresh after new raw data, run the ETL again and refresh the report.
